Nov 2018 • Family
I enjoy this type of restaurant in Saigon, we go to BBQ places like this often, it's different than the standard fare of Vietnamese cuisine and fun, I have trouble with changing the prices from Vietnamese dong to us dollars, for example 90,000 dong sounds like a lot to me but when I figure it out it's less than $4.50usd we go to these places as a family 4-5 of us in the group depending if cousins are with us and we always have fun, the food is brought out raw and you BBQ it over a grill in the middle of the table, my wife and daughters always get the goat udder, but it's a little bland for me. You can usually find these places in big shopping malls and there is a variety of BBQ places like this, this is a middle range example of these places.

Terrible service and incredibly rude staff! Don't go if you want a good experience in HCMC
Aug 2018 • Couples
Terrible service and rude staff! We visited this restaurant this evening on our 2nd day in the city and were really disappointed. The waiter mixed up our order and charged us for 2 meat platters instead of one (bearing in mind there was only 2 of us there a I am vegetarian). The cashier then decided that 10 minutes into our meal we had to pay, which we would have happily done only to realise that we had been tricked into paying for 2 platters. Our waiter came over to apologise and said that he had miscommunicated the order but the manager (standing literally no more than 2 steps away) was going to charge us as she insisted on having seen my partner point at the picture in the camera (which is not true). My partner then had to explain his frustration to a teenage manager who didn't have the audacity to come over and talk to us herself meaning it completely ruined his meal and did not finish it at the end. Our waiter was so apologetic but when we did finally pay the manager gave us a rude comment and laughed after charging us incorrectly. Terrible really points you off Vietnamese hospitality if you are a tourist!
